item.description:
About Me

I am a BSc student and aspiring cybersecurity professional currently living in the UK. I am also studying towards completing two certifications: Cisco CCNA and EC-Council CEH. Besides networking and cybersecurity I have a strong interest in everything linux and open source in general, currently daily driving an Arch setup installed and configured by myself.

(At first)This website started (as) a small personal project I decided to take on to get my HTML and CSS skills back into shape (until I got sick of updating everything manually and resorted to HUGO). As a kid I briefly played around with webpages without really understanding what I was doing — pretty much just copying snippets of html here and there, changing colours, and calling it a day. This time around I wanted to actually learn how things work and build something from scratch, however simple it may be.

Useful links

Here are some useful or simply interesting links to pages that I recommend to anyone interested in programming, technology, or just looking for some good resources to learn from.

wiby - A fast search engine to browse the old web

Distrowatch - A website for updates about Linux distributions

Artix Linux - A Linux distro based on Arch Linux but without systemd

Suckless - A collection of simple, well-designed Unix tools written in C

Setup

My setup consists of a ThinkPad P50 (i7-6820HQ, NVIDIA Quadro M1000M, 32GB of RAM). I currently dual boot between Windows 10 Pro and Arch Linux.

On the Linux side, I use a minimal configuration with a focus on performance and simplicity based on the suckless tools and vim as my primary editor.

I am actively working towards ditching Windows entirely and moving to Linux full time but at the moment I still rely on a few Windows applications for university.
